interface.name: linura_protected_display_manager_v1
interface.description: Only the independently admitted protected owner may bind this global. A surface is neither a session lock nor authority to change a display. Control separately owns canonical approval, managed prepare and execution. The compositor suppresses ordinary presentation and input while a context is active, preserving the actual ext-session-lock state independently.

request.name: begin
request.description: BOOTTIME and wall-clock deadlines are supplied by the sealed Control challenge. Neither endpoint may reconstruct one clock's deadline from the remaining budget on the other clock, including after transport delay. Zero, expired, substituted or overlong bounds fail closed.

interface.name: linura_protected_display_interaction_v1
interface.description: Surface/input epochs and both kernel clocks bind one exact native scope. Neither readiness nor consumption authenticates a human, approves a plan, grants an executor permit, configures outputs or releases a session lock. A changed scope/input/focus/topology/configure or deadline invalidates proof. The owner must separately complete its purpose-bound native authentication.

request.name: refresh_presentation

description.summary: require a fresh presented revision on every output

request.description: Reconfigure all attached surfaces within the original scope and deadline. Input and old proof remain unavailable until every new configure has a matching independently completed native frame. This cannot retarget the scope, renew a deadline or rearm a consumed interaction.

interface.name: linura_protected_display_surface_v1

description.summary: one protected surface for one exact native output

interface.description: This assigns a private compositor role to an otherwise unassigned wl_surface of the same admitted client. Configure dimensions are bounded logical pixels. Committing a buffer is not proof of presentation. Native input stays gated until every required output has independently presented a protected frame.
